title: secret-redaction-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.reference.diagnostics, identity.reference.secret-generate; exact inputs: secret_classes, encoded_variants, partial_variants, output_surfaces; initial state: the exact password, API-key, OAuth-token, private-key, cookie, DSN, and derived-fragment classes are crossed with errors, logs, traces, diagnostics, snapshots, and generated-artifact surfaces

stimulus.const: Run identity.reference.diagnostics then identity.reference.secret-generate for success, failure, denial cases using secret_classes, encoded_variants, partial_variants, output_surfaces and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: every exact class and surface pair has an independent scan result with zero full, encoded, or partial secret matches; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden; required artifact fields: secret_class_count, output_surface_count, full_secret_match_count, partial_secret_match_count, scan_digest, class_surface_results

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: every exact class and surface pair has an independent scan result with zero full, encoded, or partial secret matches; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden; required artifact fields: secret_class_count, output_surface_count, full_secret_match_count, partial_secret_match_count, scan_digest, class_surface_results

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/secret-redaction-report.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/secret-redaction-report.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest

invariant.const: every exact class and surface pair has an independent scan result with zero full, encoded, or partial secret matches

initial_state.const: the exact password, API-key, OAuth-token, private-key, cookie, DSN, and derived-fragment classes are crossed with errors, logs, traces, diagnostics, snapshots, and generated-artifact surfaces

expected_invariant.const: every exact class and surface pair has an independent scan result with zero full, encoded, or partial secret matches
